summary_en: Alfresa Holdings completed post-adjustment for its commitment-type share repurchase (FCSR), finalizing total acquisition at 6,405,200 shares (including 4,099,700 shares from shareholders other than Nomura Securities). The average price adjustment mechanism resulted in a net increase of 97,400 shares, acquired without compensation from warrant holders.
title_en: Notification of Completion of Post-Adjustment in Commitment-Type Share Repurchase (FCSR)
translation_en_brief:
Alfresa Holdings announced on November 11, 2026 the completion of post-adjustment for its commitment-type share repurchase (FCSR) program that was initiated on May 15, 2026. The final acquisition amount was determined at 6,405,200 shares, of which 4,099,700 shares were acquired from shareholders other than Nomura Securities.

The post-adjustment mechanism involved an average price calculation based on the arithmetic mean of volume-weighted average prices (VWAP) from May 19 to November 10, 2026, multiplied by 99.973%, resulting in an average price of 2,277.5342 yen per share. This calculation compared the hypothetical number of shares that would have been acquired at the average price (2,305,502 shares) against the actual shares acquired through ToSTNeT-3 from Nomura Securities on May 18, 2026 (2,208,100 shares, excluding fractional shares). The difference of 97,400 shares was settled by acquiring shares without compensation from warrant holders, increasing the total acquisition accordingly.
